server_version: version: 1 (7af4279), built with GNU 10.2.1 for Linux aarch64
probe_design: 2 images (pos real 640x480 / neg solid gray) x 6 conditions x 2 reps = 24 requests, content order text->image, max_tokens=16

seed.evidence: temp=0.5 seed=17001 twice -> byte-identical outputs (15-token sentence identical twice; chance < 1e-6)

cache_prompt.evidence: cache_prompt=false -> cached_tokens=0 in usage, both reps ~6.2s (vs 0.1-0.3s cached); default (absent) -> cached_tokens=147, rep2 0.3s
cache_prompt.caveats: field name cache_prompt accepted on chat endpoint

n_probs.evidence: n_probs=5 -> choices[0].logprobs.content[] with top_logprobs (5 candidates per token, id/token/bytes/logprob)
n_probs.caveats: chat endpoint returns logprobs in OpenAI-ish format

grammar.evidence: request-level grammar (GBNF yes/no) on chat endpoint -> outputs constrained to "Yes."/"No.", finish_reason=stop, no error
grammar.caveats: grammar string is GBNF; this server version accepts grammar on /v1/chat/completions (verified on board 7af4279)

response_format_json_schema.evidence: {"type":"json_schema",...} -> output switched to JSON ({"answer": "yes"}); pos image truncated at max_tokens=16 with finish_reason=length
response_format_json_schema.caveats: truncation risk at max_tokens=16; use larger max_tokens or prefer grammar for yes/no

usage.evidence: usage present incl. prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (0 when cache off, 147 when hit; partial 78 across-image)

timings.evidence: timings field present in all responses

notes.content_order_surprise: baseline text->image temp=0.0 on STATIC positive image produced descriptive sentence 'A industrial fan is on the corner of a shelf.' (not 'Yes.') - historical 'static images always comply' finding used image->text order; content order ablation (S2-E1) is now high priority
notes.cache_default: prompt cache defaults ON; identical-request rep2 ~0.1-0.3s (cached_tokens=147 of 148 prompt tokens)
